text: The login page 500s intermittently in prod. Find and fix it. Auth tests live in tests/auth.test.js.
I'll reproduce the failure first, then trace the auth path from the login route to the session store.
Read src/auth/session.ts
Read src/auth/login.ts

Suspicious: refreshSession resolves the token before the DB write is awaited. If a second refresh lands in the same tick we can get a torn write and the read side 500s. Confirming with the test suite.
Bash npm test -- tests/auth.test.js

> npm test -- tests/auth.test.js

  ✗ concurrent refresh keeps one session row (2 racing requests)
  ✗ token from refresh is usable on next request
  ✗ login returns 200 under load
  9 passed · 3 failed
3 failures, all around concurrent refresh — consistent with the race. Fix: serialize refreshes per user with a small in-flight map (a mutex per key), and await the write before returning.
Edit src/auth/session.ts (+14 -3)
Applied edit to src/auth/session.ts. refreshSession now goes through withUserLock(userId, …) and awaits db.sessions.put before issuing the token.
Bash npm test -- tests/auth.test.js
fetch failed: ECONNRESET — test DB container (pg-test) died mid-run. 12 tests did not complete.
The DB container crashed mid-run — that is an infra flake, not the code under test. Restarting the container and rerunning.
Bash docker restart pg-test && npm test -- tests/auth.test.js

> npm test -- tests/auth.test.js

  ✓ concurrent refresh keeps one session row
  ✓ token from refresh is usable on next request
  ✓ login returns 200 under load
  12 passed · 0 failed
Root cause: token refresh raced the session write; two concurrent refreshes could tear the row. Fix: per-user lock around refresh. All 12 auth tests green.
nice. add a regression test so this never comes back.
Edit tests/auth.test.js (+31)
Added "regression: two concurrent refreshes produce exactly one session row" — spins 2 parallel refresh calls and asserts a single row and matching token.
Bash npm test -- tests/auth.test.js
13 passed · 0 failed (0.9s)
Regression test added and passing: 13/13 green. Summary — cause: race in refreshSession; fix: per-user mutex; proof: new regression test. Done ✅
